prompt:
You are one of two AI models competing to triage a software engineer's inbox like he does. Last round he sorted the items himself in a game.
Bins:
- reply: he must write back himself
- archive: FYI / done / automatic, no action
- later: worth reading or doing, not now
- info: cannot act until a detail is supplied or clarified
- spam: marketing, noise or suspicious
Your weighted agreement with him: 33% over 40 items.
Items where you were wrong (subject -> your bin -> HIS bin):
- "Re: Platform engineer role – next step?" -> reply -> info
- "14 new jobs matching 'backend, remote'" -> archive -> spam
- "48h only: 30% off everything 🔥" -> info -> spam
- "Quick question about the log schema" -> later -> info
- "Issue 88: local LLMs on a laptop" -> info -> later
- "Your application was viewed" -> reply -> spam
- "Invoice 3391 – payment overdue" -> info -> reply
- "[games] New issue: runner lags on old Android" -> later -> info
- "Dataset access – which split?" -> info -> spam
- "Gemma, Qwen and Llama compared on CPU" -> info -> later
His sorts by sender type: collaborator: info 4, spam 3, reply 2; github: archive 2, later 1, info 1, reply 1; invoice: archive 4, reply 1, info 1; job-board: spam 4, archive 2, later 1; marketing: spam 6, info 1; newsletter: later 5, spam 1; recruiter: info 5, reply 3, spam 2; service: archive 4, reply 2, later 1
Your summary badges won 2/3 of the A/B style questions he answered.
Tasks:
1. Write a revised sorting rubric: 3 to 5 short rules that would match HIS sorting better.
2. Write 10 NEW fictional inbox items of the kinds he gets: recruiter replies, job-board digests, code-host (CI/PR/issue) notifications, service notices, marketing, collaborator questions, invoices, newsletters. Make some of them hard to sort.
Rules for items: sender is a role plus a made-up company, like "Recruiter · Pinewood Talent" or "Code host notifications"; NO personal names, NO email addresses, NO URLs, NO phone numbers, no placeholders like [name]. subject max 60 characters, snippet is one full sentence of 40 to 110 characters (the first line of the mail body). senderType one of: recruiter, job-board, github, service, marketing, collaborator, invoice, newsletter. Give your bin for each.
Example item (do not copy it): {"senderType":"recruiter","sender":"Recruiter · Pinewood Talent","subject":"Re: Backend role, quick follow-up","snippet":"Thanks for applying. Are you open to a 20 minute call on Thursday or Friday?","badge":"question","bin":"reply"}
Return JSON only, exactly 10 parcels: {"rubric":["rule 1","rule 2","rule 3"],"parcels":[ ... ]}
raw:
